title: Two Cards, Handed On at Random

scenes.tts: Mendel counted 7,324 seeds from his round by wrinkled pea hybrids. That is 2.96 round for every wrinkled seed. Yet the hybrids themselves had all been round. So the wrinkled form vanished, then came back in about one seed in four. What must a plant carry to give those numbers?
scenes.visual: A bar of 7,324 seeds splits 5,474 round to 1,850 wrinkled with 2.96:1; all-round hybrid seeds with a ghost wrinkled slot; question about what the plant carries.
scenes.narration: Mendel counted 7,324 seeds from his round by wrinkled pea hybrids. That is 2.96 round for every wrinkled seed. Yet the hybrids themselves had all been round. So the wrinkled form vanished, then came back in about one seed in four. What must a plant carry to give those numbers?

scenes.tts: Think of each plant as holding two cards for seed shape. Each card is an allele. Capital R is the round allele. Small r is the wrinkled allele. A hybrid holds one of each, so its genotype is R small r. When it makes eggs and pollen, it hands one card, at random, into each. So it makes R and small r gametes in equal numbers.
scenes.caption: Think of each plant as holding two cards for seed shape. Each card is an allele. Capital R is the round allele. Small r is the wrinkled allele. A hybrid holds one of each, so its genotype is Rr. When it makes eggs and pollen, it hands one card, at random, into each. So it makes R and r gametes in equal numbers.
scenes.visual: Two blank cards in a plant become R and r; the plant hands one card into each gamete, giving R and r gametes in equal numbers.
scenes.narration: Think of each plant as holding two cards for seed shape. Each card is an allele. Capital R is the round allele. Small r is the wrinkled allele. A hybrid holds one of each, so its genotype is Rr. When it makes eggs and pollen, it hands one card, at random, into each. So it makes R and r gametes in equal numbers.

scenes.tts: Now let the hybrid pollinate itself. Its eggs and pollen meet at random. R meets R and gives R R. R meets small r and gives R small r. So does small r meeting R. And small r meeting small r gives small r small r. The offspring are one quarter R R, one half R small r, and one quarter small r small r.
scenes.caption: Now let the hybrid pollinate itself. Its eggs and pollen meet at random. R meets R and gives RR. R meets r and gives Rr. So does r meeting R. And r meeting r gives rr. The offspring are one quarter RR, one half Rr, and one quarter rr.
scenes.visual: A 2 by 2 square fills cell by cell with RR, Rr, Rr, rr; a tally 1/4 RR, 1/2 Rr, 1/4 rr appears.
scenes.narration: Now let the hybrid pollinate itself. Its eggs and pollen meet at random. R meets R and gives RR. R meets r and gives Rr. So does r meeting R. And r meeting r gives rr. The offspring are one quarter RR, one half Rr, and one quarter rr.

scenes.tts: Now ask what the seeds look like. One R is enough to make a round seed. So R R and R small r look the same. Only small r small r seeds are wrinkled. Mendel called round the dominant character, and wrinkled the recessive character, the one that becomes latent. So three quarters of the seeds are round, and one quarter are wrinkled.
scenes.caption: Now ask what the seeds look like. One R is enough to make a round seed. So RR and Rr look the same. Only rr seeds are wrinkled. Mendel called round the dominant character, and wrinkled the recessive character, the one that becomes latent. So three quarters of the seeds are round, and one quarter are wrinkled.
scenes.visual: Seeds appear in the square cells; the RR and Rr rows merge under a brace into 3/4 round, rr stays 1/4 wrinkled.
scenes.narration: Now ask what the seeds look like. One R is enough to make a round seed. So RR and Rr look the same. Only rr seeds are wrinkled. Mendel called round the dominant character, and wrinkled the recessive character, the one that becomes latent. So three quarters of the seeds are round, and one quarter are wrinkled.

scenes.tts: Round seeds should hold two kinds of plant that look alike. Mendel grew 565 plants from round seeds and let each one pollinate itself. 193 gave only round seeds. 372 gave round and wrinkled seeds again, at about three to one. So about one third were R R, and about two thirds were R small r.

scenes.visual: Two look-alike round seeds with question marks; a bar of 565 plants splits 193 only round, 372 round and wrinkled; genotypes RR and Rr appear under them.

scenes.tts: This is the law of segregation. The two alleles of a plant separate into different gametes. Each gamete carries one. Keep two things apart. Three to one is a phenotype ratio. It is what you see. One to two to one is a genotype ratio. It is what the plant carries.
